## isNotInstanceOf() function

Check that a value is \*not\* an instance of one or more prototypes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function isNotInstanceOf<T, U extends Function[]>(value: T, ...prototypes: U): value is Exclude<T, InstanceOf<U>>;
```
